name: Ampleon USA Inc.
old_description: The advent of 5G NR (New Radio) since 2019 has ushered in a new era with demanding prerequisites for RF power components. Ampleon stands at the forefront, providing market leading RF power solutions for mMIMO (Massive Multiple Input Multiple Output) of up to 128 simultaneous transmit and receive streams, high efficiency small cell, and high-power macro base stations.
about:
Ampleon USA Inc. maintains a sales and engineering office at 310 George Washington Highway in Smithfield, Rhode Island, as part of the global Ampleon organization headquartered in Nijmegen, Netherlands. The company operates a dedicated production facility in Cabuyao, Philippines, and holds additional sales offices across China, Finland, France, Korea, Sweden, Taiwan, and a second U.S. location in Dallas, Texas.

The company designs and manufactures RF power transistors, including gallium-nitride-on-silicon-carbide (GaN-on-SiC) HEMT devices and silicon LDMOS discrete transistors. These components serve 5G New Radio infrastructure such as massive MIMO arrays with up to 128 simultaneous streams, high-efficiency small cells, and high-power macro base stations. Ampleon also supplies solid-state RF generators for particle accelerators and industrial heating applications, with power levels ranging from kilowatts to megawatts.

Ampleon’s customer base spans telecommunications equipment makers, industrial and scientific research facilities, and medical technology manufacturers. The company’s distribution network covers the Americas, EMEA, South Asia Pacific, Japan, China, and Korea, supported by a team of manufacturer’s representatives covering all 50 U.S. states and international distributors.

Ampleon emphasizes its focus on high-efficiency, high-power RF solutions that enable the transition from vacuum-tube to solid-state technology in particle acceleration and industrial heating, while delivering the density and performance required for advanced 5G base station architectures.
